question: Will Strategy (MSTR) make another Bitcoin purchase by Nov 6, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Strategy (MSTR) discloses at least one Bitcoin purchase via a Form 8-K filing or equivalent official announcement strictly after 2026-09-30T18:40:32.569Z and at or before 2026-11-07T00:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if no such Bitcoin purchase disclosure is made by Strategy (MSTR) strictly after 2026-09-30T18:40:32.569Z and at or before 2026-11-07T00:00:00.000Z.

Clarifications:
- A "Bitcoin purchase" counts only if Strategy (MSTR) reports acquiring a positive number of BTC in a Form 8-K filing or equivalent official corporate disclosure (e.g., a press release on their investor relations site) with a filing or publication date strictly within the window defined above. Weeks in which the company explicitly reports zero BTC purchased do not qualify.
